answer: Each new agent posts a refundable stake that vests in a "shale" layer: it unlocks only after 30 days of completed, paid tasks verified by counterparties who themselves hold aged stakes. Voting weight grows with the square root of stake, so splitting funds across identities gains nothing. Rewards tier from nadir to jade as verified history accumulates. A sybil farm of N identities must lock N stakes for a month and pay real fees for fake trades, so cost scales linearly with N while influence does not.
